name: hospital-microservices
description: Node microservice workspace for admin, patient, and doctor services.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n gateway,admin,patient,doctor "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:patient" "npm run dev:doctor"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n gateway,admin,patient,doctor "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:patient" "npm run start:doctor"
